# Environment variables

Every variable governance can find across the backend settings, both environment templates,
and the Compose files. Names and classifications only — no value that could be a credential
appears here or in any other governance artifact.

| Class | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `runtime` | Read from the environment when the process starts. |
| `build-arg` | Baked into an image at build time. Changing it needs a rebuild; a restart will not pick it up. |
| `computed` | Derived by the settings object from other variables. **Not settable** — setting it has no effect. |
| `secret` | Credential. Never given a default here, whatever the source says. |
| `deprecated-alias` | Kept for compatibility; use the variable it aliases. |
| `compose-only` | Consumed by Compose, not by the application settings. |
| `unknown-consumer` | Present in a template with no reader found. Setting it does nothing. |

### Self-hosted Codecov (Compose profile `codecov`)

| Variable | Required | Default | Class | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CODECOV_COOKIE_SECRET` | no | *(secret — never recorded)* | `compose-only`, `secret` | Session cookie signing key (long random string; rotating it logs everyone out) |
| `CODECOV_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` | no | — | `compose-only` | GitHub OAuth App used to log in to the Codecov UI. Authorization callback URL: http://localhost:8090/login/github (dev) or https://codecov.<DOMAIN>/login/github (prod) |
| `CODECOV_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET` | no | *(secret — never recorded)* | `compose-only`, `secret` | — |
| `CODECOV_GLOBAL_UPLOAD_TOKEN` | no | *(secret — never recorded)* | `compose-only`, `secret` | Optional instance-wide upload token; CI can use it as CODECOV_TOKEN with the repo slug. Leave empty to require per-repository tokens from the Codecov UI. |
| `CODECOV_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | no | *(secret — never recorded)* | `compose-only`, `secret` | Signing secret for the GitHub webhook Codecov creates on each activated repository. Set it BEFORE activating a repository: Codecov bakes the value into the hook at creation and then rejects any delivery whose HMAC does not match. Empty is not "verification off" — unsigned deliveries are rejected too, so an empty value yields a hook that 403s on every delivery. To change it later, edit or recreate the "Codecov Webhook" entry under the repository's GitHub webhook settings. Only matters once GitHub can reach the instance; a localhost-only instance receives no deliveries either way. Coverage uploads do not depend on this — webhooks only keep PR comments and statuses prompt. |
| `CODECOV_POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | no | *(secret — never recorded)* | `compose-only`, `secret` | Codecov's own PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB (never the application database) |
| `CODECOV_MINIO_ROOT_USER` | no | *(secret — never recorded)* | `compose-only`, `secret` | Codecov's own MinIO for report archives (never the application bucket) |
| `CODECOV_MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD` | no | *(secret — never recorded)* | `compose-only`, `secret` | — |
